name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kaufland_marketplace-mcp
description: Kaufland Global Marketplace (sales channel) + Marketplace Seller API (ecommerce suppliers): me, list

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Kaufland Marketplace Client Key (32 characters, seller portal API settings), sent as the Shop-Client-Key header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Secret Key (64 characters): signs every request (hex HMAC-SHA256 over METHOD, full URI, body and Unix timestamp joined by newlines, sent as Shop-Signature with Shop-Timestamp). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KAUFLAND_MARKETPLACE_STOREFRONT
environmentVariables.description: Kaufland storefront for product calls: de, cz, sk, pl, at, fr, it, es or nl (GET /v2/info/storefront lists yours).
